notes: WooCommerce + Elementor, but the product grid on this category page is rendered by a custom 'tuoteslideri' (product slider/grid) widget rather than the standard WooCommerce ul.products markup - use .tuoteslideri-grid-item as the container, not .product/li.product. 30 products all loaded in the initial DOM on one page (no visible pagination controls or ?page= links found) so treated as a single page. Stock status uses colour-coded meta badges: span.tuoteslideri-meta.is-green (e.g. 'toimitus', 'Saatavilla myymälästä') = in stock/available; span.tuoteslideri-meta.is-red ('Ei saatavilla') = out of stock - both confirmed present in the sample. Price uses WooCommerce's standard .woocommerce-Price-amount markup nested inside .tuoteslideri-price-value, comma decimal separator with a non-breaking space before the € symbol.
